categories.name: 1 Player
categories.description: Single-player games you can enjoy on your own, from quick puzzles to long adventures.
categories.intro: Games with a real single-player mode: a story, a campaign, puzzles, or opponents controlled by the computer. Online-only games that need other people are left out.

categories.name: 2 Players
categories.description: Games for two people: couch co-op, head-to-head duels and online games for a pair of friends.
categories.intro: Everything here works with exactly two people. Use the Mode filters to choose between sharing a screen and playing online, or between teaming up and competing.

categories.name: 3 Players
categories.description: Games that work with three players, a group size many games quietly skip.
categories.intro: Three is an awkward number for a lot of games. These all support three players in one session, locally or online.

categories.name: 4 Players
categories.description: Games for four players: couch party games, four-player co-op and full online squads.
categories.intro: The classic couch-and-controllers group size. Filter by Local multiplayer if everyone is in the same room.

categories.name: 5+ Players
categories.description: Games that support five or more players, for bigger groups and parties.
categories.intro: Five or more people in one game. Many of these use phones, browsers or online lobbies so nobody needs a spare controller.

categories.name: Party
categories.description: Party games built for groups: easy to learn, quick rounds and plenty of laughs.
categories.intro: Quick to explain, quick to play, and better with a crowd. Most rounds take minutes, so people can drop in and out.

categories.name: Local multiplayer
categories.description: Local multiplayer games you play together in the same room, on one screen or one device.
categories.intro: Couch games: everyone plays on the same screen or passes the same device around. No second copy and no internet connection needed for the multiplayer part.

categories.name: Online multiplayer
categories.description: Online multiplayer games to play with friends or strangers over the internet.
categories.intro: Play together from different places. Check each game page for what you need: some run in a browser tab, others need a store account.

categories.name: Local co-op
categories.description: Couch co-op games where friends in the same room work together on one screen.
categories.intro: Team up on the same sofa. Every game here has a cooperative mode that works on one screen or one device.

categories.name: Online co-op
categories.description: Online co-op games to play with friends over the internet, from quick missions to long campaigns.
categories.intro: Work together over the internet. Great when your group lives in different places.

categories.name: Co-op
categories.description: Cooperative games where players work together instead of against each other.
categories.intro: Everyone on the same side. Includes local and online co-op; use the Mode filters to narrow it down.

categories.name: PvP & versus
categories.description: Competitive PvP games where players go head to head, locally or online.
categories.intro: Player against player. Duels, free-for-alls and team matches, on one screen or online.

categories.name: Team-based
categories.description: Team-based multiplayer games where squads compete or cooperate.
categories.intro: Games built around teams: two-versus-two, five-a-side and squads.

categories.name: Turn-based
categories.description: Turn-based games where you take your time: board games, card games and tactics.
categories.intro: No reflexes required. Players take turns, so these are relaxed to play and easy to pass around.

categories.name: Action
categories.description: Fast action games that test reflexes and timing.
categories.intro: Quick reactions and constant movement, from co-op shooters to roguelikes.

categories.name: Adventure
categories.description: Adventure games with worlds to explore and stories to uncover.
categories.intro: Exploration and discovery first. Many of these are best played over several sittings.

categories.name: Arcade
categories.description: Arcade games with simple rules, fast rounds and high replay value.
categories.intro: Pick up and play. Short rounds, simple controls and one more go.

categories.name: Board
categories.description: Digital board games, from chess to modern tabletop favourites.
categories.intro: Classic and modern board games you can play on a screen, alone against the computer or with friends.

categories.name: Card
categories.description: Card games and deckbuilders for solo sessions and head-to-head matches.
categories.intro: Deckbuilders, collectible card games and card-based puzzles.

categories.name: Casual
categories.description: Relaxed casual games that are easy to pick up and put down.
categories.intro: Low pressure and easy to learn. Good for a short break or for people who don't play much.

categories.name: Fighting
categories.description: Fighting games, from one-on-one duels to four-player platform brawlers.
categories.intro: Head-to-head fighters and chaotic party brawlers. Add a player filter to find ones for your group size.

categories.name: Horror
categories.description: Horror games to play alone with the lights off or with friends for backup.
categories.intro: Scary games, solo and co-op. The co-op ones are often as funny as they are frightening.

categories.name: .io
categories.description: Browser-based .io games: free, instant, massively multiplayer rounds.
categories.intro: Open a tab and you're in a match with other players. No download and usually no account.

categories.name: Platformer
categories.description: Platformers about running, jumping and precise movement.
categories.intro: Jumping puzzles, tight controls and hand-built levels, solo and co-op.

categories.name: Puzzle
categories.description: Puzzle games that reward logic, pattern spotting and a bit of lateral thinking.
categories.intro: Brain teasers of every size, from a daily word puzzle to hundred-hour logic games.

categories.name: Racing
categories.description: Racing games from kart battles to open-world driving.
categories.intro: Karts, cars and chaos. Several of these support split-screen for racing on one TV.

categories.name: RPG
categories.description: Role-playing games with characters to grow and worlds to explore.
categories.intro: Characters, choices and progression. Most of these are long games best enjoyed over many sessions.

categories.name: Sandbox
categories.description: Sandbox games where you build, experiment and set your own goals.
categories.intro: Open-ended games with few rules and lots of tools.

categories.name: Shooter
categories.description: Shooter games, from co-op missions to competitive team matches.
categories.intro: First- and third-person shooters, competitive and cooperative.

categories.name: Simulation
categories.description: Simulation games about farming, driving, building and running things.
categories.intro: Relaxing routines and systems to manage.

categories.name: Sports
categories.description: Sports games, from realistic to wildly arcade.
categories.intro: Ball games, golf and sports that don't exist in real life.

categories.name: Strategy
categories.description: Strategy games that reward planning, from tower defense to grand empires.
categories.intro: Think ahead. Real-time and turn-based strategy, tactics and MOBAs.

categories.name: Survival
categories.description: Survival games about gathering, crafting and staying alive, often with friends.
categories.intro: Gather, build and survive. Most of these shine in co-op.

categories.name: Tower Defense
categories.description: Tower defense games: place defences, stop the waves, upgrade and repeat.
categories.intro: Build towers along the path and hold the line.

categories.name: Play on GameAtlas
categories.h1: Games You Can Play Right Here
categories.description: Free games you can play instantly on GameAtlas, with no download and no account.
categories.intro: Small original games made for GameAtlas. They run in this page, work offline once loaded, and never show ads inside the game.

categories.name: Free
categories.description: Free games, including free-to-play games with optional purchases.
categories.intro: Free to start playing. Some are free-to-play with optional purchases; each game page says which.

categories.name: Browser
categories.description: Browser games you can play in a tab on any computer, no install needed.
categories.intro: Everything here runs in a web browser.

categories.name: No download
categories.description: Games you can play without downloading or installing anything.
categories.intro: Nothing to install. Handy on a shared or locked-down computer.

categories.name: Mobile
categories.description: Games you can play on a phone or tablet.
categories.intro: Available as a phone or tablet app, or playable in a mobile browser.

categories.name: PC
categories.description: Games for Windows PC and other desktop computers.
categories.intro: Games you can install on a computer.

categories.name: Console
categories.description: Games available on Nintendo, PlayStation or Xbox consoles.
categories.intro: Available on at least one current or recent console.

categories.name: Quick games
categories.description: Quick games you can play in under 10 minutes.
categories.intro: A full round, match or puzzle in under ten minutes.

categories.name: Family
categories.description: Family-friendly games suitable for younger players and mixed groups.
categories.intro: Friendly content and simple controls, chosen for mixed-age groups. Always check the rating in your region.
